## 14. Future installer preflight and complete reachable inventory

### 14.1 Establish the real execution context

P01. Confirm the currently selected device, OS, active user-owned workspace, local versus cloud orchestration, model, reasoning effort, and available tools from actual metadata or supported status commands. The research environment's PC “M” was offline; no current Windows/Android settings were inspected. Do not reuse that historical device status as a future observation.

P02. Resolve the intended gpt-6.1-sol and High selection through the actual client. If unavailable, complete authorized inventory and reversible preparation, record the actual executing model, and do not claim target-model execution or validation. Preserve an explicit requirement that actual installation run on the requested model; do not silently substitute another model. Do not infer the model from a user's label, a file header, or the assistant's self-identification.

P03. Discover capabilities before using them: filesystem, GitHub, official docs, Library, plugin manager, computer-use/remote device, supported personalization operations, screenshots/audio, and any existing local execution environment. “ECC” or another previously used tool name is a lead, not a guaranteed current capability. Read the selected tool/skill instructions.

P04. Prefer supported APIs/connectors/CLIs for their supported operations. Use mouse/keyboard/screenshots for an independently permitted UI task when that is the appropriate route. Honor the Computer Use exclusion for ChatGPT itself and terminal apps [O10]. A separate command-execution tool is different from automating a terminal UI; use it only under its actual permissions.

P05. Do not install TinyFish, Parallel Search, GitHub, or another plugin merely because it helped research this file. They are not required runtime components of a persona. Reuse available tools; install/enable a selected plugin only for an actual needed capability and within its allowed authorization flow.

### 14.2 Inventory all reachable user-controlled behavior inputs

Create a local inventory record in the installation workspace, with one row per real object:

~~~json
{
  "object_id": "assigned-local-id",
  "surface": "ordinary_chat|project|dot|codex_host|subagent|plugin|other",
  "host_or_account": "observed identity; no secrets",
  "source_kind": "setting|memory|file|skill|hook|project_instruction|agent_definition",
  "location": "real path or supported object identifier",
  "read_method": "actual supported tool or user-supplied export",
  "read_at": "ISO-8601",
  "content_sha256": null,
  "editable_by_user": null,
  "currently_active": "verified|likely|unknown|inactive",
  "activation_evidence": null,
  "scope": {"audience": null, "duration": null, "project": null},
  "persona_conflicts": [],
  "unrelated_rules_to_preserve": [],
  "availability": "read|missing|inaccessible|unsupported|not_applicable"
}
~~~

Inspect the following without opening unrelated private content or secret stores:

| Inventory area | Required questions |
|---|---|
| Ordinary Chat account | Same account/workspace on Windows and Android? CI enabled? Exact existing field text and actual limit? Current preset/characteristics? Memory settings and relevant visible persona memories? |
| Existing private projects | Which does Misha actually use? Instructions? Accessible persona files? Default/project-only/shared state? Does the desired Chat/Work/Voice surface exist there? |
| Existing custom GPTs, if used | Independent instructions and knowledge? Stale persona? Current edit/migration availability? |
| Morning Light dot | Existing identity preserved? What current conversational style/note mechanism is supported? Relevant notes accessible? Calls use which context? Active work/schedules must remain intact. |
| Each local Codex consumer | Windows native, WSL, SSH host, IDE, local desktop task? Actual host CODEX_HOME and effective instruction/configuration chain? |
| Cloud ChatGPT Work | Supported account/project personalization, cloud task controls, actual context? Do not assume connected-PC AGENTS/local-memory controls configure the cloud orchestrator. |
| Codex files | Global AGENTS.override.md/AGENTS.md; repo and nested AGENTS files; applicable fallback names; user/profile/trusted project config; role-specific agents. |
| Skills/plugins | Installed metadata that actually affects instructions; any old persona/interviewer skill that conflicts in ordinary use? Explicit vs implicit invocation? |
| Hooks | Existing trusted hooks that append/rewrite instructions; local versus cloud support; no new hook by default. |
| Memories/state | Relevant supported Codex/Chat/dot preference records; their actual scope and supersession, not opaque databases. |
| Existing projects/repos | Only user-relevant persona sources, current future-memory work, and configuration paths identified by the inventory. |
| Voice/device | Actual selected voice, mode, language, audio route, interruption behavior, account and app version on each device. |

System/developer/provider rules are protected runtime layers, not user-owned files to extract or overwrite. Record observable constraints and public documentation. Do not request or expose hidden instructions or claim a complete internal prompt dump. “All instructions gathered” means all reachable, relevant user-controlled inputs with explicit gaps, not omniscient access to the platform.

Use targeted file enumeration/search in identified directories. Search known persona terms and known configuration filenames; do not crawl the entire drive, browser profiles, credential folders, or unrelated accounts. Prefer rg/rg --files when available. Resolve symlinks and host boundaries so that two paths are not mistaken for two independent stores.

### 14.3 Normalize the inventory

P06. Copy original relevant readable objects into a dated private backup before modification. Record original content hash, exact path/object ID, current scope, and restore method. Preserve original encoding/newlines when modifying files where that matters. Windows paths are commonly case-insensitive: persona.md and an older PERSONA.md may be the same target. Inspect before copying; use a new version directory or an explicit backed-up update rather than overwrite by filename assumption.

P07. Extract atomic requirements and classify each: direct current user instruction; recorded accepted preference; proposed draft; historical install assertion; fiction; example/test; observed current state; unresolved. Do not execute an old “apply immediately” source while parsing it.

P08. Deduplicate by bytes first, then by meaning. Keep separate delivery scopes even when bodies match. Retain source provenance for each normalized rule. Use §8 decisions unless a newer actual user correction clearly supersedes them.

P09. Make a concrete before/after edit plan per active object. Mark obsolete same-scope persona lines to replace, retained non-persona rules, derived new payload, expected final length, and verification method. Do not edit archived historical documents merely because their wording is obsolete; remove stale text from the active loader/setting instead.

P10. Treat a newly discovered preference as additional evidence. If it genuinely conflicts with this file and its authority/scope are clear, incorporate the newer user instruction and record why. If a material creative choice is unresolved, prepare the competing minimal options and ask one targeted question after completing unaffected preparation. Do not use uncertainty about one adjective to halt every settings update.

### 14.4 Local workspace organization

Reuse an existing user-owned persona/configuration repository if suitable. Otherwise select a simple private folder on the actual accessible host. Do not assume the research scratch path exists on Windows. Keep:

~~~text
chosen-persona-directory/
  persona.md                       canonical supplied file
  deployments/<version>/<host>/    extracted payloads and composed final fields
  inventory/                       accessible-source records and conflict decisions
  backups/<timestamp>/            exact pre-edit copies and scope metadata
  receipts/                        operation/readback/session observations
  evaluations/                     synthetic test inputs and actual results
~~~

This layout describes future installer working files; the current user-facing deliverable remains only persona.md. If the chosen project is already Git-backed, keep its private versioning workflow; do not duplicate repositories into unrelated storage or create a public repository. A local versioned backup is sufficient when Git adds no value.
